name: – Ana Catarina Mendes – After § 61 – Am 13
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text: 61a. Stresses the importance of the effectiveness of the system for returning illegally staying third-country nationals; highlights the need to make more ambitious proposals to ensure that all return decisions issued by the Member States are immediately executed, and to establish new sanctions and/or tariffs on non-cooperative third countries;
